messages:
lina: ok but seriously... Peanut just photobombed my standup by sitting ON MY LAP and refusing to move. sending pics 43648b
photo-bot: lina uploaded 2 files
ben: that forehead smoosh is a perfect medium for sticky notes 60d
tara: can we make a 'peanut break' channel? mandatory pet cameos in every meeting 60a
lina: also note: Peanut loudly judged my code review at 10:02am. i took it personally :cry:
ben: proposal: Peanut = official office morale officer. plaque ideas? suggestions welcome.
ops-bot: quick poll created: "Peanut for Morale Officer?" options: Yes / Heck yes / Vote with treats
tara: "Vote with treats" is the only valid democratic system
ben: will donate 3 treats. who else? i'll start a tiny piggy jar on the bookshelf.
lina: note to future self: avoid wearing socks during Peanut cameo, they will be stolen. true story.
tara: also, can someone photoshop Peanut into the team holiday card? i will pay in cookies.
ben: caption ideas: "When you ship fast but nap faster" or "Chief SNACK Architect"
lina: love both. added to the #design-requests list. also planning a 'Peanut Tuesday' rota so he can visit other desks.
tara: Peanut 10/10 would be scooped into a giant blanket burrito. end thread.
